title: 云依助手 0.13.8
releaseNotes: Makes packet traffic logs taller with at least 320px of readable content and the remaining workspace height. Empty saved-packet libraries use compact spacing; the library can be collapsed without changing data or active sessions. Short windows and wrapped status details may scroll vertically instead of squeezing logs. Default-size send controls remain visible, and new traffic stays within the bounded console. Packet sending, replies, multicast and network debugger functionality are unchanged. Includes layout and synthetic transport regression coverage.
